text:
Alex Cheng: Hey team — received my remote Mac mini (M2) yesterday. Trying to enroll into Kandji but enrollment stuck at 'Awaiting user approval'. It's headless (no monitor in my home office) so I can't see the approval prompt. FileVault didn't escrow either. Also need my SSH key added to /Users/alex/.ssh/authorized_keys for remote dev. Tried rebooting and connecting via USB-C display adapter (no luck). Any way to get a temp admin or push the approval from IT?

Beth Patel: Welcome Alex! We can push a temporary admin account and trigger FileVault escrow from our side. Can you confirm the device serial? (or send screenshot of Kandji device page). Also what's your availability for remote session? :wave:

Alex Cheng: serial: C02X7A0LPL2R. Available 10–11am PT. Here's the Kandji page screenshot link: https://share.internal/abc123 (placeholder)

Kandji Bot: Device C02X7A0LPL2R currently 'Enrolled: Partial' — FileVault escrow pending.

Matt Rivers: I can push a one-time local admin and escrow key. Steps I'll run: 1) create temp user 'temp-admin-alex', 2) add your ssh pubkey to your account, 3) trigger FV2 escrow. After you confirm SSH access, we'll remove the temp account. Alex, paste your public key here or DM me. :lock:

Alex Cheng: pasted in DM. Thanks! Quick question — will this break my ABM assignment or existing user? I have a personal AppleID signed in under the device.

Beth Patel: No, we won't change ABM. We will create a local admin only. If you have personal AppleID, keep it logged out until we finish FileVault escrow. We'll note this incident in the ticket.

Matt Rivers: Pushed temp-admin and escrow triggered at 2087654400. You should be able to ssh to macmini.local. Let us know if you can't connect.

Alex Cheng: SSH worked! :tada: FileVault shows 'escrowed' now in Kandji. Can you remove temp-admin after 11:30am PT?

Matt Rivers: Temp admin removed at 2087654580. Left a note in the ticket with recovery key stored in our vault. Benched instructions: run `sudo fdesetup list` if you want to verify locally.

Beth Patel: All set. Closing the loop — filed ticket #IT-4921 with details and recovery key location. Welcome aboard, Alex! :party:

Alex Cheng: Thanks y'all!
